title: Small dwelling subject to the site area concession: maximum internal floor area 60 m2
text: Small dwellings subject to the site area concession of C4.1.4, C4.1.5 or C4.1.6 shall comply with the following: i. a maximum internal dwelling floor area of 60m2; ii. parking provided in accordance with Table 2.3a; and iii. all other provisions of the R-Codes.

replaces.note: Part B small dwelling (R30 and R40, 70 m2); the concession now reaches R10-R25 apartments via C4.1.4

verified.note: Heading on p25 cites 'C4.1.3, C4.1.5 and C4.1.6'; the clause cites C4.1.4, C4.1.5 or C4.1.6. 60 m2 confirmed.

notes: from: ch3 C2.9.1. diverges: maximum 60 m2 (Chapter 3: 70 m2) and the concession clauses are C4.1.4, C4.1.5 or C4.1.6. Only (i) is encoded: (ii) parking per Table 2.3a is empty for residents (no minimum, register C4P1-066) and is tested by C2.3.1; (iii) applies via the other rules. verify: the heading above the clause cites 'C4.1.3, C4.1.5 and C4.1.6' while the clause cites C4.1.4.
